min_demand_threshold.verbatim: each of whose aggregate demand across all retail schedules exceeds 30kW

aggregation_rules.detail: Customers with multiple accounts, some under 30 kW, may aggregate all nonresidential accounts.
aggregation_rules.verbatim: will be allowed to aggregate all Nonresidential accounts

min_contract_duration.detail: Subscribing customer elects a term of 5 to 20 years, consistent with the renewable supplier contract or resource life.
min_contract_duration.verbatim: for a term between 5 and 20 years

direct_cost_assignment.detail: Rider charges pass the subscribing customer the cost of acquiring the renewable resource and running the program.
direct_cost_assignment.verbatim: The Rider rate will pass to Subscribing Customers the costs of acquiring the renewable energy resource and operating this supplemental program

dca_generation_capacity.detail: Cost of the dedicated renewable resource is charged to the subscriber, net of energy and capacity value credits.
dca_generation_capacity.verbatim: The Rider rate will pass to Subscribing Customers the costs of acquiring the renewable energy resource and operating this supplemental program

customer_resource_procurement.detail: Customer subscribes to a share of a new renewable facility, either PGE-procured (PSO) or customer-selected (CSO).
customer_resource_procurement.verbatim: a Nonresidential Customer may purchase a subscription share of a new renewable

customer_led_procurement.detail: Customer Supply Option lets customers with more than 10 aMW identify and select a resource contracted as a PPA or company-owned resource.
customer_led_procurement.verbatim: means a resource identified and selected by the Customer

exit_fee.detail: Early termination or default is governed by termination and default provisions in the subscription agreement; no fee formula in the tariff.
exit_fee.verbatim: shall be subject to termination and default

hold_harmless.detail: Non-subscribing customers bear no resource, administrative or program costs apart from the energy and capacity value credits.
hold_harmless.verbatim: Non-subscribing Customers will not be subject to resource costs, administrative costs, or
